body_excerpt: CodeQL 2.27.4 improves accuracy and query metadata - GitHub Changelog Skip to content Skip to sidebar / Blog Changelog Docs Customer stories Try GitHub Copilot app See what's new Search Changelog Docs Customer stories See what's new Try GitHub Copilot app Back to changelog Improvement November 4, 2026 • 2 minute read CodeQL 2.27.4 improves accuracy and query metadata Table of Contents Query changes CodeQL CLI Menu. Currently selected: Query changes Query changes CodeQL CLI CodeQL is the static analysis engine behind GitHub code scanning, which finds and remediates security issues in your code. We’ve recently released CodeQL 2.27.4 with query accuracy improvements across several languages, stronger security checks when you bundle or publish a pack, and corrections to query metadata. Query changes Java/Kotlin The java/log-injection query now recognizes additional sanitizers and sanitizer guards from the JDK, Apache Commons Lang and Text, Guava, OWASP Java Encoder, and Spring Framework. Path-injection queries now recognize additional substring guards and string replacement and removal operations from Apache Commons Lang and Guava. Rust We have reduced false positives in the rust/uncontrolled-allocation-size , rust/log-injection , and rust/cleartext-logging queries. C/C++ The cpp/suspicious-pointer-scaling query no longer reports intentional pointer arithmetic on std::byte* buffers. The cpp/unused-local-variable and cpp/unused-static-variable queries no longer report variables marked with [[maybe_unused]] . CWE metadata changes CodeQL no longer applies the CWE-730 tag to the following queries: C# : cs/redos and cs/regex-injection . Java/Kotlin : java/redos , java/polynomial-redos , and java/regex-injection . JavaScript/TypeScript : js/redos , js/polynomial-redos , js/regex-injection , js/regex-injection-more-sources , js/server-crash , and js/loop-bound-injection . Python : py/redos , py/polynomial-redos , and py/regex-injection . Ruby : rb/redos , rb/polynomial-redos ,
